added_findings.title: VV's project sync deletes every published statement picture from R2
added_findings.detail: WCP/Tools__DevUtils/AutomationUtil__SyncSingleProject__ToCloudAndWeb__Main__.py na_purge_stale_r2_images (:659-680; called at :926 and :959 on every sync) lists VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/ with no Delimiter (first 1,000 keys, unpaginated). It then deletes every .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp whose bare file name is not a top-level image of the local project folder (na_collect_local_image_names :645-656 uses iterdir()). The statement layout in S07b-F30 puts every published picture under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/10__StatementDocs/, so the next sync after a Publish would delete them all, and the web reader would show the broken pictures TV v2.171 fixed. Markdown, HTML and JSON survive because the purge is gated on extension. The local prune (:298-300) only touches top-level IMG* files, so local statement folders are safe. S08 found the same fault for published drawings (WP-S08-04).
added_findings.recommendation: Fix before the first VV statement Publish, through WP-S08-04: purge top-level keys only (Delimiter='/'), which protects 10__StatementDocs/ along with the other sub-folders, and add a 10__StatementDocs/ key to its dry-run acceptance. If WP-S08-04 chooses a skip-list instead, 10__StatementDocs/ and 00__* must be on it.
added_findings.evidence: Sync script :645-680 (purge logic), :926 and :959 (call sites), :921-924 (r2_prefix = VaApps/Projects/{full_year}/{folder}); S08 report lines 450-458 and WP-S08-04.

added_findings.title: Statement file names would carry the raw ?project= folder id as {code}, slash included
added_findings.detail: Na__LeStmt__NameFor and Rename (Data__.js :833-842, :929-937) pass Na__LeStmt__ProjectCode || Na__DrawData__GetProjectCode() as {code}, and Na__LeStmtIdx__NameFor (Data__Index__.js :239-251) writes String(code) unsanitised into '{code}_T{tranche}_S{number}__{project}__{title}__.md'. VV's Na__DrawData__GetProjectCode() (42/Na__DrawView__ProjectData__.js :224-229) is the loading sequence's raw ?project= value (Na__AppFlow__LoadingSequence.js :672, :729). Whitecardopedia launches VV with ?project=<folderId> (61__Feature__PwaAppHelpers/Na__Feature__PwaAppHelpers__ValeVisionLinkRouting__Logic__.js :36-54; ImageCarousel.jsx :92-95), e.g. '2026/3047__Doous'. A new VV statement would therefore be named '2026/3047__Doous_T01_S01__...md': the '/' makes it a nested path, which the segment pattern and fences would refuse. The same value also reaches the index's Project key and the published page's na-project-code meta (harmless). The survey's examples assume the code is '3047'. VV project.json has projectCode '3047', projectName 'Doous' and folderId '2026/3047__Doous'.
added_findings.recommendation: In the Data adaptation, use a VV code for {code}: the numeric prefix of the normalised folder (NormalizeProjectFolderId(...) last segment before '__' -> '3047') or project.json projectCode. Use the folder name minus that prefix for {project} ('Doous'). Follow the same rule D-S07a-03 settles for Vale Document IDs (13 codes are shared by scheme variants). Better: back-port a config-driven code/name derivation to TV (S07b-F51) so Data__ ports verbatim.
added_findings.evidence: Data__.js :833-842, :929-937; Data__Index__.js :239-251; VV ProjectData :224-229; LoadingSequence :672, :729; ValeVisionLinkRouting :52-54; WCP/Projects/2026/3047__Doous/project.json.

S07b proposes a new per-document client (Na__AppUtils__R2StatementDocs__, F28) and a rewritten Transport unit (F07), with Cards, Publish and Publish__Images re-routed (F14, F18). Elsewhere:

- S07a D-S07a-08 A proposes the same facade at TV's paths.
- S08 adds the two ProjectLoader facades (wiring note 8) but a per-feature client for published documents (WP-S08-06).
If both approaches are built, VV gets two statement transports.
added_findings.recommendation:
Decide D-S07b-10 before WP-S07b-03 and WP-S07b-05B. Recommended: (a), in line with D-S09-04 and D-S07a-08. Then:
- Data__Transport__, Publish__ and Publish__Images__ port verbatim.
- The statement functions of the VV CfApi/LocalMirror shims are built over the new worker routes (F27) and the Flask blueprint (F26).
- StatementFileLocation returns a 404-honest local URL (blueprint GET or /Whitecardopedia/Projects/..., never the catch-all route, F29) that carries Last-Modified.

added_findings.title: Statement worker routes: store without caching and do not bump the shared build manifest per file
added_findings.detail: VV's CloudflareHandler__DrawingNotes__ stores with httpMetadata.cacheControl 'no-cache, max-age=0' and calls na_write_build_manifest on every POST (:120-140). That rewrites VaApps/Index/Na__BuildVersion__Manifest__.json with a new unix-time buildVersion (ProjectEditor handler :160-171). VV's ProjectLoader appends that buildVersion as ?v= to every project.json and GLB URL (Na__AppUtils__WithBuildToken :249-252, used at :407-408, :514, :519), so each bump makes every client re-download every project's models on its next load. A statement Publish writes dozens of pictures plus md, html and index; a handler copied from DrawingNotes would bump the global token dozens of times per Publish. Statement reads do not use the token.
added_findings.recommendation: In CloudflareHandler__StatementDocs__ (or the shim's worker routes): store the index, md and html with cacheControl 'no-cache, max-age=0', the DrawingNotes convention, so a re-publish shows at once. Store pictures with an explicit policy. Do not call na_write_build_manifest per write; at most once, on the index write that Publish makes last, or not at all. Add both rules to WP-S07b-03's acceptance.

added_findings.title: WP-05, WP-06 and WP-07 cannot land separately; the writing surface needs ProjectQrCode
added_findings.detail:
Internal import graph (01-Oct):
- Page__ imports Publish__ (07), Standard__Registry__ and Standard__DrawingSchedule__Live__ (09).
- Editor__ and Editor__Cards__ import Standard__Registry__.
- The Registry imports all six section modules, including TrueVisionHub__, which statically imports ProjectQr Symbol, Painter and ProjectLink.
- Publish__ imports the Registry and ProjectQr Symbol.
So the original WP-S07b-05 (Page, Editor, Cards...) can neither link nor pass its acceptance before WP-06 and WP-07, and none of them can load before the ProjectQrCode port (WP-S07a-04). By contrast, 18 files have no external imports and can land early as inert modules: Data__Index, Images, the five Md modules, Editor__Move, Editor__Typing, Publish__Page, Contents, DrawingSchedule, Finishes, Header, Footer, the Config JSON and both CSS files.
added_findings.recommendation:
Re-cut the packages:
- WP-S07b-05A: the pure modules, landed inert.
- WP-S07b-05B: Data, Transport, Reader and Manager, after the transport and config.
- WP-S07b-05C: Registry, Hub, Editor, Cards, Figure, Pdf, Publish, Publish__Images and Page, in one landing after QR, sharing, keys and the menu renderer.
Run Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__.mjs after each.

added_findings.title: Context-menu renderer leaf and its stylesheet have no owning WP
added_findings.detail: The Statement Page (:159) and Editor__Figure__ import Na__ContextMenu__Ui__Open and Na__ContextMenu__Ui__Close from 27__System__ContextMenuSystem/Na__ContextMenuSystem__Ui__MenuRenderer__.js. That file is 1.0.0, 394 lines and has no imports; layout defaults are built in and ApplyConfig is optional. Its CSS (Na__ContextMenuSystem__Styles__.css, 157 lines, only .na-context-menu* rules) reaches TV pages only through TV's app CSS index (:103). S09 marks 27 'port with 52 Statement' and S10 marks it optional (wrongly saying it has no LE use); no WP ports the leaf.
added_findings.recommendation: Own it here as WP-S07b-11: port the renderer and the CSS verbatim at the TV path (VALEVISION3D header, PORT NOTE), and link the CSS through the VV loader's STYLESHEETS (WP-S03a-07 pattern) or VV's CSS index. Do not port SystemLogic, RightClickGuard, HitResolver or the Sections; the 3D right-click menu is a separate decision (S09/S10).
added_findings.evidence: MenuRenderer :40-110 (constants, defaults, no imports), exports :386-391; TV CSS index :103; S09 :307; S10 :407, :487.

added_findings.title: A shared statement link must itself load VV's lazy editor
added_findings.detail: TV starts Share__Open__ at boot (Index.html :904 import, :1738 call). Share__Open__ imports the ModeController directly (:67-69), reads the open parameter through Share__Links, waits for Na__LeMode__Ready and calls Na__LeMode__OpenStatements({statementId, view:'read'}) (:276, :283, :317-333). S07b-F35 says VV must start Share__Open__ 'through the loader once the editor has loaded', which is circular: in VV nothing loads the editor until a tab is pressed, so a reader opening a shared statement link would land on the 3D view.
added_findings.recommendation: VV needs a boot-time check of the share parameter that does not import the editor graph (a small leaf, or the loader facade). When a link is present, it calls the loader (Na__LeLoad__OpenStatements / OpenSpecification / OpenRegister, or one generic facade entry) to load the editor; Share__Open__ then runs inside the loaded editor. Own it in WP-S08-11 / WP-S09-12 (index wiring for 66 'via the loader facade'); S07b only supplies the statement entry point.
added_findings.evidence: TV Index.html :904, :1734-1738; Share__Open__.js :67-89, :270-290, :317-341; VV Loader header (editor modules are only ever import()ed).

added_findings.title: Cross-slice ownership overlaps in S07b's work packages
added_findings.detail:
Several S07b items are already scoped by other slices' WPs and would be built twice:
- Lockstep leaf: WP-S07b-01 vs WP-S06b-01 (STMT-01).
- KeyScope + HotkeyHandler gate: WP-S03a-03, WP-S05a-01, WP-S09-05.
- DocumentKeys: WP-S03a-09, WP-S05a-02.
- Loader VIEW_STATEMENT/OpenStatements: WP-S03a-05, WP-S09-03 vs WP-S07b-08.
- TabStrip 2.0.0 statements tab: WP-S03a-06, WP-S10-04 vs WP-S07b-08.
- LayoutEditor__Statement__Config, labels and EditorSetup GetStatementSetup: WP-S03a-01 (whole TV config) vs WP-S07b-04.
- Open Sans 500: WP-S10-09 vs WP-S07b-04.
- html2canvas vendor: WP-S09-10 vs WP-S07b-04.
- PdfExporter LoadLibrary: WP-S08-14 (re-sync to 1.12.0) / WP-S08-02 vs WP-S07b-04's alias.
- Confirm-dialog back-port to TV: WP-S10-07 vs S07b-F42.
- The ModeController statement hunk follows WP-S03a-12's per-feature template.
added_findings.recommendation:
Assign one owner each:
- Lockstep: WP-S06b-01.
- KeyScope: one of the three keyboard WPs.
- DocumentKeys: WP-S03a-09.
- Loader facade: WP-S03a-05.
- TabStrip: WP-S03a-06.
- Config block: WP-S03a-01; WP-S07b-04 then sets only the VV statement values and the Enabled switch.
- Fonts: WP-S10-09.
- html2canvas: WP-S07b-04 or WP-S09-10, not both.
- LoadLibrary: the alias only if WP-S08-14 has not landed.
WP-S07b-08 keeps only the ModeController statement hunk (per WP-S03a-12), the share entry (S07b-V07) and the SW token. The S07b packages then depend on those owners.
added_findings.evidence: Work-package headings in S03a, S05a, S06b, S08, S09 and S10 (grep of the slice reports, 01-Oct).

added_findings.title: VV node suites need the QR port, VV's ProjectLoader seam and a VV address bar
added_findings.detail: Four suites copy TV's 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ProjectLoader.js into their scratch tree and simulate TV's address bar: Standard, Schedule, Finishes, Publish (Standard :76-83: ?project=RB05&project-folder=RB05__WestFarm&year=26). The Standard suite also copies the whole 51__System__LayoutEditor/53__Feature__ProjectQrCode folder (:72) and checks the QR module size (:260-265). In VV these suites cannot run until the QR port exists and the ProjectLoader facade (or adaptation) is settled. Their address simulation must use VV's ?project=2026/3047__Doous. The Standard suite has 47 checks (42 pass + 5 fail on 01-Oct).
added_findings.recommendation: In WP-S07b-09: point the copy lists at VV paths (VV ProjectLoader with facades, VV QR folder), simulate a VV address, and sequence the Standard suite after WP-S07a-04. RoundTrip, FigureTitle and Lockstep need only feature files and can run as soon as WP-S07b-05A (and WP-S06b-01) lands.
added_findings.evidence: Na__Test__StatementStandard__.test.mjs :66-83, :260-265; copy lists of Schedule, Finishes and Publish (each names 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ProjectLoader.js).

added_findings.title: Off-localhost acceptance needs a port other than 8000/8090
added_findings.detail: WP-S07b-06's acceptance reads the Read view 'off localhost (*.localhost host)'. VV's Na__AppUtils__IsRunningOnLocalhost (ProjectLoader :303-307) returns true for port 8000 whatever the hostname (TV's for 8000 and 8090), and WCP Flask binds 127.0.0.1:8000 (server.py :74-75). A *.localhost host served by WCP Flask therefore still counts as localhost. TV proved its reader from 'reader.localhost:8864' (devlog v2.171 :106-110).
added_findings.recommendation: State the acceptance as 'served on a *.localhost host at a port other than 8000/8090 (e.g. reader.localhost:8864), with every non-read request aborted', in WP-S07b-05C and WP-S07b-09.
added_findings.evidence: VV ProjectLoader :303-307; TV ProjectLoader :67-71; WCP server.py :74-75; TV devlog :106-110.

added_decisions.question: How does the VV Statement Writer reach R2 and the local server: same-name CfApi/LocalMirror shims, or its own per-document client?
added_decisions.options: (a) Same-name VV shims (D-S09-04 (a), D-S07a-08 A): the statement functions of Na__CfApi__* and Na__LocalMirror__* are built over the new worker routes and the Flask blueprint, and Data__Transport__, Publish__ and Publish__Images__ port verbatim. (b) S07b's per-document client Na__AppUtils__R2StatementDocs__, with a rewritten Transport unit and re-routed Cards, Publish and Publish__Images (S07b-F07, F18, F28).
added_decisions.recommendation:
(a), to match the transport decisions of S09 and S07a and keep three more files identical to TV. Under either option keep:
- VV's authenticated per-route worker (S07b-F50).
- 404-honest local reads (S07b-F29).
- No-cache storage and no per-write build-manifest bump (S07b-V04).
- The sync-purge fix before the first Publish (S07b-V01).

notes:
The survey is strong. Its scale, paths, versions, line references, test results and VV-absence claims held up against the files. I re-ran the 7 TV node suites and got identical results, and I reproduced the CRLF tokeniser defect directly. No finding is refuted outright.

Material problems:
- **Missed critical, S07b-V01.** VV's project sync purges every R2 image under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/ that is not a top-level local image, so every published statement picture would vanish on the next sync. It needs WP-S08-04, scoped to protect 10__StatementDocs/.
- **Missed high, S07b-V02.** `{code}` in statement file names would be '2026/3047__Doous', with a slash.
- **Transport strategy conflict, D-S07b-10.** S07b's per-document client contradicts the same-name shim strategy of S09 (D-S09-04) and S07a (D-S07a-08); the planner must pick one before WP-03/05B.
- **Work packages.**
  - WP-01 duplicates WP-S06b-01.
  - WP-05/06/07 cannot land separately: the Page imports 07 and 09, and the Editor and Cards reach ProjectQrCode through the Registry and Hub.
  - I re-cut them as 05A (inert pure modules), 05B (data and transport binding) and 05C (one landing), and added WP-S07b-11 for the ownerless context-menu renderer.
- **F34 overstated and understated.** Plain Backspace is not stolen (it is Alt+Backspace, and F is Alt+Shift+F), but d, o, Delete and Escape are swallowed too. The same leak affects VV's existing plan-annotation contenteditable editor today; this is outside the slice, so tell the keyboard slices (S03a/S05a/S09), which list only R, B, T, Y and the digits.
- **F01/F54 framing.** The feature is in Adam's live use (v2.169-v2.172 are his reports), so the gate is a pinned commit plus his go-ahead for Vale, not a pending confirmation.
- **F48/b.11 sizing.** The VV prerequisite set is 17 files / 7,001 lines, not 115 / 47,730.

Watch for:
- Several S07b items overlap other slices' packages (loader facade, TabStrip, config block, Open Sans 500, html2canvas, LoadLibrary, KeyScope, DocumentKeys); see S07b-V08 and assign single owners.
- VV's get_project_path has no '..' fence, so the new blueprint must fence the project folder itself.
- The Drawing Register is still an open Adam decision (D-S07a-01). Until it is made, the VV Page drops its static DrawingSchedule__Live__ import.

Report edited in place, with an appended ## Verification section. Scripts are in scratchpad/parity/verify_s07b.
